description: REQ-PMTRADE(d) mandates starting with 'arbitrage pair-cost (buy YES+NO when combined < $1)' as the highest-win-rate first strategy. pm-paper.py's discover() only reads toks[0] (the first/YES CLOB token) per market and calls book() on that single token; it never fetches the complementary NO-outcome token's book, so ask_yes and ask_no are never both surfaced together anywhere in the tool output. arb_pair_profit(ask_yes, ask_no) in lib.py therefore has no live data source that could feed it inside this slot's actual data path — the mandated 'first strategy' cannot be executed with the shipped tool.
